name: loopthink
description: Connect Google Search Console, Google Ads, GA4, Stripe, HubSpot and your own APIs and databases to ChatGPT through one governed MCP gateway.

interface.longDescription:
loopthink is a hosted MCP gateway. You connect the systems you already run, and your whole team reaches them through one connector in ChatGPT.

Ready-made connectors:
- Google Search Console: search performance per property, by query, page, country and device
- Google Ads: campaign, ad group and keyword reporting per account
- Google Analytics 4: reports for the properties you pick
- Stripe: customers, subscriptions, invoices and payouts, read-only
- HubSpot: contacts, companies, deals and tickets, per object type
- Plus 60 more apps, your own REST API, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, DynamoDB, an n8n workflow, or any MCP server you already run

Sign in with Google for the Google connectors, or paste an API key. Pick which properties and accounts your team may see. Everything is read-only unless you say otherwise.

Built for teams: every person signs in with their own account, access is granted per member group, personal fields can be masked server-side before a result reaches the model, and every tool call is logged with who ran it. Hosted in the AWS European Sovereign Cloud.

Google Search Console and Google Ads answer right here in this app. For every other system, connect it in loopthink and add your workspace to ChatGPT as a connector.
capabilities: Report on Google Ads campaigns and keywords
Read Stripe customers, subscriptions and payouts
Read HubSpot contacts, companies and deals
Query your PostgreSQL or SQL Server database
Call your own REST API as named tools
Proxy an MCP server you already run
defaultPrompt: Which Search Console queries lost the most clicks in the last 28 days?
Show me Google Ads spend by campaign for last month.
Compare GA4 sessions this week against the same week last month.

positive.prompt: What can you read in my loopthink workspace?
positive.expected_behavior: List Google Search Console and Google Ads with whether each is connected, naming the servers, and give the connect link for any that is not.

positive.prompt: What were the top 10 search queries for my site over the last 28 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Call gsc_list_sites for the siteUrl, then gsc_search_analytics with dimensions ["QUERY"] and dateRange LAST_28_DAYS, and return queries with clicks, impressions, CTR and position.

positive.prompt: Do my sitemaps report any errors?
positive.expected_behavior: Call gsc_sitemaps for the property and report each sitemap with last download, URL counts and errors.

positive.prompt: Which Google Ads accounts can I report on?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the connected Google Ads accounts with customerId, name and the loopthink server each belongs to.

positive.prompt: What did each campaign cost and convert in the last 7 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Call google_ads_report with the customerId, resource "campaign", metrics such as cost_micros, clicks and conversions, and dateRange LAST_7_DAYS, and return one row per campaign.

negative.description: No write access to Search Console
negative.prompt: Submit a new sitemap at /sitemap-2.xml for my site.

negative.description: No data outside the connected properties and accounts
negative.prompt: Show me the search performance of https://www.google.com/.

review.commerce_description: loopthink does not sell products or process payments inside ChatGPT. Subscriptions are purchased on www.loopthink.ai.

publication.release_notes: loopthink_status takes an optional goal argument: the user's request in one sentence, so loopthink can see which data source the user needs. No other tool changes; listing unchanged.
